title: Pessoa Analista de Infraestrutura Júnior (Field)
description:
Descrição da vaga

Prazer, Grupo SBF. Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas. Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil; da FitDance e da OneFan, aqui o movimento não para. Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado, o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gerenciar e dar suporte à infraestrutura tecnológica das lojas (servidores de loja, estações de PDV, impressoras fiscais/não fiscais, leitores de código de barras e pin pads).
  • Atuar em incidentes de nível 2 e 3 que impactem a operação de vendas e o atendimento ao cliente, garantindo o rápido restabelecimento dos serviços.
  • Coordenar a manutenção corretiva e preventiva de equipamentos de TI nas unidades, interagindo com fornecedores e técnicos de campo.
  • Realizar configurações e atualizações de firmware e software específicos do ambiente de loja.
  • Administrar a rede local (LAN) das lojas, incluindo switches, access points Wi‑Fi e links de comunicação (WAN).
  • Monitorar e otimizar a conectividade entre a loja e o Datacenter/Cloud, assegurando a estabilidade da transmissão de dados de vendas (vendas, estoque, transações).
  • Participar da padronização e implementação de configurações de segurança de rede (firewalls e VPNs) específicas para o varejo.
  • Definir o layout físico e lógico da infraestrutura de TI nas novas unidades, garantindo a conformidade com os padrões da empresa.
  • Implementar soluções de gerenciamento centralizado e inventário de ativos de loja.
  • Desenvolver e manter a documentação dos ambientes de loja (diagramas de rede, manuais de configuração de PDV e procedimentos de troubleshooting).
  • Elaborar planos de contingência e procedimentos operacionais para minimizar o impacto de falhas na infraestrutura de loja.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior em TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Sólida experiência em infraestrutura de TI, com vivência comprovada em ambientes de varejo ou com unidades dispersas.
  • Forte domínio na gestão de ambientes de Ponto de Venda (PDV) e seus periféricos.
  • Conhecimento avançado em redes LAN/WAN e gerenciamento de ativos de rede.
  • Experiência em suporte a Sistemas Operacionais Windows (principalmente em terminais de varejo) e servidores locais de loja.
  • Habilidade com rotinas de backup e restauração de dados críticos de loja.

Local: Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Fundada em 20 de agosto de 1972, a Unimed do Estado do Rio de Janeiro – Federação Estadual das Cooperativas Médicas (Unimed Ferj) atua há 52 anos como representante estatutária de todas as Unimeds do estado. Ao longo de sua trajetória, a Unimed Ferj tem desempenhado um papel fundamental na promoção da conformidade regulatória e na implementação das melhores práticas de gestão entre as cooperativas do sistema Unimed no Rio de Janeiro.

Com uma governança corporativa voltada para a sustentabilidade e uma cultura organizacional focada em pessoas, a Unimed Ferj é uma referência no Sistema Unimed fluminense, que gera aproximadamente 16 mil empregos diretos e conta com uma ampla rede credenciada. Esses fatores contribuem para que o Sistema Unimed seja reconhecido como referência em Saúde Suplementar no Brasil.

Na função de Operadora de plano de saúde, a Unimed Ferj se dedica a oferecer um atendimento de excelência a mais de 470 mil clientes, por meio de uma ampla rede de médicos cooperados, unidades próprias e serviços credenciados.

Desde abril de 2024, a Unimed Ferj assumiu a gestão, o dimensionamento estrutural e o direcionamento assistencial do Hospital Unimed e dos Prontos Atendimentos Unimed na cidade do Rio de Janeiro. Nas unidades próprias, são mais de 2.400 profissionais comprometidos e dedicados a oferecer um cuidado humanizado e de excelência aos nossos pacientes.

Buscamos pessoas que valorizam as relações humanas e abraçam novas oportunidades. Na Rede Própria da Unimed Ferj, promovemos a diversidade, respeitamos diferentes ideias e perspectivas, e vivemos os princípios do cooperativismo, sempre com foco na excelência do cuidado.

Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Production Engineering (or a related field) and 5 to 7 years of experience in the role.

PMI Certification.

description:
Select how often (in days) to receive an alert:

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

You’ll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end — from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high-quality software — and help the team grow in the process.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non-functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards.
  • Build and deliver using our technology stack (see below) with focus on quality, performance, and observability.
  • Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium-sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on-time delivery.
  • Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders.
  • Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality.
  • Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools.
  • Client interaction: attend remote and in-person meetings, capture requirements, discuss trade-offs, and present solutions clearly.
  • Mentor others: guide mid-level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture.
  • Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals.
  • Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post-mortems.
  • Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
  • Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field.
  • Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects.
  • Stack: Backend (Java, Python and .Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event-driven architectures.
  • Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability.
  • Quality & DevOps: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments.
  • Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing).
  • Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client-facing).
  • Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.

Nice to have:

  • Postgraduate or Master’s degree.
  • IaC (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
  • Multi-cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.
  • Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.g., Kafka), and feature flag management.

title: Líder De Operações Logísticas, Amxl Amazon Logistics
description:
Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria. Sejam itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes.

A equipe da Amazon Logistics Brasil (AMZL) está procurando uma pessoa Líder de Operações Logísticas para se juntar ao time de transportes, especificamente para a operação AMXL (Amazon Extra Large) - nossa operação dedicada para produtos grandes e pesados. Esta é uma operação estratégica focada em itens Big Non-Sort e Heavy and Bulk, que demandam processos logísticos especializados e diferenciados.

As operações serão feitas 7 dias por semana, incluindo feriados; portanto, trabalhar em diferentes turnos será parte dessa função.

Você atuará na gestão de uma equipe de parceiros logísticos externos especializados em produtos grandes e pesados, como também gerenciará uma equipe de analistas de operações logísticas, que também serão funcionários Amazon, para garantir o desempenho e conformidade dos processos desses parceiros. Trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas.

Key job responsibilities

Fazer a gestão do time de Analistas de Operações Logísticas, garantindo o desenvolvimento e performance da equipe em um ambiente de operação especializada em produtos grandes e pesados (AMXL)

Atuar como ponto focal de relacionamento e acompanhamento de métricas dos parceiros logísticos especializados em AMXL, responsáveis pelas estações de entregas

Acompanhar e garantir a execução dos treinamentos específicos para manuseio de produtos grandes e pesados, além de projetos de melhoria contínua dos parceiros logísticos AMXL

Criar, acompanhar e analisar métricas operacionais e financeiras específicas da operação AMXL com os parceiros logísticos, incluindo indicadores de capacidade, utilização de frota especializada, e performance de entrega

Analisar dados de várias fontes, identificar tendências relevantes para que, a partir deles, decisões rápidas e importantes ao negócio sejam tomadas

Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos relacionados à logística de produtos grandes e pesados, considerando as particularidades de manuseio, transporte e entrega

Servir de elo entre os stakeholders internos e externos relacionadas às operações AMXL

Mergulhar profundamente nas causas raízes dos problemas operacionais específicos da operação AMXL, propondo e implementando soluções escaláveis

Apoiar os lançamentos de novos parceiros logísticos especializados em AMXL, garantindo a correta implementação de processos e padrões de qualidade

A day in the life

Como Líder de Operações Logísticas AMXL, você será o ponto central entre a Amazon e nossos parceiros logísticos. Seu dia começará revisando métricas operacionais - volumes entregues, performance de entrega (OTD), incidentes de manuseio, e utilização de capacidade da frota AMXL.

Você trabalhará com stakeholders internos e gerenciará sua equipe de Analistas de Operações Logísticas. Com os parceiros logísticos externos, conduzirá reuniões operacionais revisando KPIs como FTDS, DEA, e custos operacionais, identificando gaps e implementando melhorias de processo.

Você também será fundamental no onboarding de novos parceiros AMXL.

About the team

O time de AMXL Brasil faz parte da Amazon Logistics e é responsável por revolucionar a entregas no país. Somos uma equipe altamente colaborativa, orientada por dados e focada em inovação, onde testamos novas ideias constantemente e valorizamos a autonomia e o senso de dono. Trabalhamos em um ambiente dinâmico similar a uma start-up, onde cada membro tem voz ativa e contribui diretamente para melhorar a experiência do cliente final. Nossa missão é garantir que produtos cheguem aos clientes brasileiros com a mesma excelência operacional e rapidez que caracterizam a Amazon, superando desafios logísticos complexos todos os dias.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Work a flexible schedule / shift / work area, including weekends, nights, and / or holidays
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or experience in Engineering, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Experience in people management
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Visio, and MS Project) at an advanced level
  • Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
  • Experience in high-volume manufacturing operations or sourcing environments
  • Travel up to 80% of the time

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

As the key financial leader for Area Brazil and Argentina, you will act as copilot of the Country Managing Director (CMD) and be responsible for all local finance and commercial management matters. Partnering closely with the CMD, you will play a critical role in steering the direction and success of the organization by providing timely and accurate financial insights and demonstrating strong business acumen. You will lead and oversee all aspects of controlling, accounting, reporting, internal control, commercial management, fiduciary responsibilities, treasury, and tax matters to sustainably optimize business performance and financial position. Representing the company externally, you will ensure full compliance with all legal requirements and internal policies. The Country Finance Manager (CFM) reports to the Global Division Controller & Commercial Manager Service and the Country Managing Director.

Strategic Leadership : Contribute to the local implementation of the Accelleron business strategy, providing strategic financial leadership and direction.

Business Planning : Develop and translate strategy into comprehensive business plans (budget / forecast), set measurable targets, and coordinate / oversee the corresponding processes. Assess financial implications of strategic decisions, create, and evaluate business scenarios, and initiate corrective actions when necessary.

Performance Management and decision support : Monitor financial performance across multiple dimensions, delivering insights to support both operational and strategic decision‑making. Drive cost structure optimization, productivity improvements, and capital efficiency to maximize value creation.

Commercial and Risk Management : Identify and communicate commercial and financial risks and opportunities arising from business propositions, such as contracts. Conduct risk and contract reviews in line with global policies and standards to minimize risks and exposure. Monitor overdue accounts to mitigate default risk and safeguard company assets.

Financial Reporting : Establish and oversee processes and tools to ensure transparent and reliable financial data, reported in compliance with Group standards (US‑GAAP) and financial closing schedules.

Accounting and Statutory Reporting : Ensure accurate financial bookkeeping (via our external Accounting Service Provider) in accordance with local accounting principles. Ensure timely preparation of accurate statutory financial statements.

Tax Compliance : Responsible for the preparation and filing of accurate tax returns (including timely payment) for corporate income taxes, transfer pricing and indirect taxes, in collaboration with your tax service provider. Ensure adherence to Accelleron tax policies as well as local and international tax regulations to ensure full tax compliance. Monitor changes in local tax legislation and assess their impact with local and global experts.

Governance, Compliance, and Audits : Establish and maintain local governance in line with corporate standards, regulations, policies, and legal requirements. Ensure effective execution of internal controls for financial and specified non‑financial operations. Coordinate external audits and support internal audits, acting as a liaison with the global legal and integrity function.

Act as Secretary to the Board of Directors. Ensure regulatory filings, reporting, and other general affairs tasks.

Treasury Management : Secure, plan and manage the company's liquidity, including investment and debt management. Responsible for the local bank relationships, including the management of bank accounts, bank guarantees and other local banking services. Identify and manage foreign exchange risks, implementing hedging strategies in accordance with Group policies. Oversee the company's local insurance policies and credit risk management in alignment with Group guidelines.

Your Background

University degree in Finance / Controlling or Chartered Financial Accountant (e.g., ACCA, ACA, ICAEW, ICAS, CPA, CIMA) or extensive practical work experience with demonstrated achievements.

Up‑to‑date knowledge of local statutory accounting principles (BR GAAP, ARG GAAP) and US‑GAAP / IFRS, combined with practical application experience.

Demonstrated experience in tax compliance, specifically in preparing and filing corporate income tax returns, managing transfer pricing, and handling indirect taxes.

Strong financial background with a structured and results‑oriented approach and exceptional analytical skills.

High IT proficiency with experience in SAP (S4Hana is a strong advantage) and Microsoft Office products.

Proven team player with strong problem‑solving skills, an open‑minded approach to challenges, and the persistence to deliver on time.

Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously, ideally with corresponding work experience from within a matrix organization.

7+ years of experience in a controlling / accounting role within an international environment, preferably with an industrial background.

Demonstrated leadership skills with a commitment to coaching and developing team members to reach their professional goals.

description:
Job Description

We are recruiting, on behalf of one of our clients in the Oil & Gas industry, a "STRUCTURE CONSTRUCTION LEAD (M / F)" for a long‑term contract based in Rio de Janeiro (Brazil). This mission is on a residential basis, with no option for rotation.

Mission Context

  • Support the Operations Team in managing structural integrity of the fleet in Brazilian waters, minimizing risks of failure, pollution, water ingress, and major structural damage.

Key Responsibilities

  • Resolve structural hull integrity issues by proposing technical solutions and coordinating offshore repairs.
  • Develop inspection plans tailored to the company requirements, based on past reports or identified risk areas.
  • Act as a focal point with inspection vendors, engineering suppliers, and Class surveyors.
  • Suggest innovative, cost‑effective, and productivity‑enhancing solutions.
  • Provide offshore support to the Marine Team on structural / class inspections and regulatory compliance.
  • Assist offshore teams during Class surveys.
  • Oversee and control project schedules.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering.
  • Experience in greenfield and brownfield offshore structural projects.
  • Background in shipyards, fleet structural teams, inspection, or offshore repair companies.
  • Solid knowledge of offshore structural materials, fabrication, and installation.
  • Experience in constructability reviews.
  • Proven skills in material estimation, scheduling, resource planning, and development (revamp project experience a plus).
  • Ability to create repair plans from inspection reports and coordinate with Engineering and Class for complex structural studies.
  • Strong knowledge of offshore structural repair requirements, inspection standards, and best practices.
  • Proficiency in English.

Interested in this position? Send us your application.

EP2C Energy is committed to diversity and inclusion. We strongly encourage applications from individuals with disabilities.

As part of our Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) policy, we place the utmost importance on complying with HSE rules to ensure a safe working environment for all our employees, while aiming to contribute positively to environmental sustainability. By joining our teams, you will be expected to follow procedures and HSE best practices, while also contributing to the continuous improvement of our processes.

EP2C – Who are we?

  • EP2C is a rapidly growing technical assistance company specializing in Energy (Renewables, Oil & Gas, Nuclear), Life Sciences (Pharmaceutical, Cosmetics, and Food Industries), and Large-Scale Industrial Projects (Mining, Construction, Water Treatment, Petrochemicals, and Chemicals).
  • Thanks to our international presence (subsidiaries in Latin America, Africa, and Asia), we work with major players in our fields and offer exciting career development opportunities in France and abroad.
  • A human‑sized company, we are committed to supporting and personally developing our employees, recognizing their expertise and contribution.
  • Joining EP2C Energy means becoming part of a human adventure and an ambitious mission.

About BX Studio

BX Studio is one of the world’s leading Enterprise Webflow agencies—and the 2025 Webflow Enterprise Partner of the Year. We specialize in launching custom websites, ongoing website optimization, and digital branding.

We’re a remote-first team of ambitious, creative collaborators focused on delivering exceptional digital experiences for the world’s most forward-thinking brands.

We’ve partnered with Reddit, Headspace, NBC, and Verifone, spoken at Webflow Conf four times, and have been a trusted Webflow Enterprise Partner since 2020.

The Role

We’re building our pipeline of vetted creative partners for near‑term and future collaborations. This role is ideal for designers interested in working with BX Studio on an ad hoc project basis as opportunities align.

We’re looking for a Graphic & Motion Designer to help bring SaaS and digital‑first brands to life through compelling visual and motion storytelling. You’ll collaborate with senior designers and art directors to design product‑driven graphics, animations, and illustrative elements that enhance websites, pitch materials, and brand systems.

This is a hands‑on creative role focused on craft, consistency, and collaboration—you’ll be designing, animating, and refining visual assets that make complex ideas feel clear, cohesive, and engaging.

What You’ll Do

Design and animate graphics for SaaS interfaces, abstractions, data visualizations, and infographics that communicate product stories with clarity and impact.

Develop brand‑aligned illustrations and visual systems that extend client assets across digital experiences.

Design brand and sales collateral including pitch decks, social graphics, reports, and client‑facing documents for both digital and print applications.

Storyboard and concept short animations that demonstrate product value or explain key interactions.

Collaborate with UX, web, and motion leads to ensure visual consistency and seamless integration across site designs.

Support design and production of brand collateral, pitch decks, social graphics, and internal marketing materials.

Translate feedback from senior designers and clients into clear creative refinements.

Stay current on visual, animation, and data‑driven design trends, bringing fresh ideas to the team.

What We’re Looking For

2–4 years of experience in graphic or motion design , ideally within an agency or digital‑product setting.

Strong portfolio showcasing UI abstractions, product graphics, data visualization, and motion design.

Experience working with B2B or SaaS brands a plus.

Proficiency in Figma, After Effects, Illustrator, and Photoshop (bonus : InDesign, PowerPoint, or light 3D).

Strong sense of composition, hierarchy, and animation timing.

Comfortable following established brand systems while contributing original ideas.

Organized, detail‑oriented, and reliable in meeting deadlines across multiple projects.

Enthusiasm for collaboration and openness to feedback from senior team members.

Why Join BX Studio?

Collaborate with award‑winning designers and developers on world‑class Webflow and brand projects.

Shape high‑impact visual storytelling for leading B2B and consumer technology brands.

Join a remote‑first, high‑performing team that values craft, clarity, and creative rigor.

Contribute to an agency recognized as the 2025 Webflow Enterprise Partner of the Year, helping define the next evolution of web design.

We strive to be the go-to company that partners with businesses to optimise their HR technology landscape.

What is the role about?

We are looking for an experienced Workday Integrations Developer with a strong Payroll integration experience (can be either integration with Workday Payroll or 3rd party Payroll systems), who is based in the Latin America time zone.

As a Workday Integrations Developer, you will design, build, and maintain integrations between Workday and Payroll systems, ensuring seamless data flow and accuracy.   • Optimise and enhance existing integrations to improve performance and scalability.

What skills are we looking for?

Our roles are remotely based (even pre‑Covid), meaning you will be working from your home office, connecting with your client and team on a daily basis.

To be successful in this type of environment, you will need to have the ability to communicate effectively (in English) with cross‑functional teams, explain complex concepts in easy, understandable terms, align HR / business knowledge with Workday functionality, and proactively drive process improvements. You will need to be comfortable with video calls and be proactive in keeping communication channels open with your client and team.

Skills and Experience Required

  • 3 - 5 years’ Workday Integration and implementation experience including payroll integrations (either Workday Payroll and/or 3rd party payroll systems);
  • 5+ years of experience in the application of modern integration technologies (EDI, Web Services, XML, XSLT, Java, .Net, middleware).

  • Excellent technical communication skills are essential.
  • Fluent in English (writing, reading, and speaking).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (writing, reading, and speaking).
  • Ability to work independently and cross‑functionally.

Other Qualifications/Skills that will be beneficial but not mandatory

  • College or University Degree in HR or Information Systems.
  • Experience with any of the following: Java, JavaScript, .NET, XSLT, NetBeans IDE development background.
  • Experience in other critical corporate platform implementations such as Workday, Oracle, PeopleSoft, Sailpoint, SAP, Siebel, MuleSoft, Dellboomi, or applications built on AWS services.

As this is a remote role, you can be based anywhere in the Latin America region so long as you are authorised to work without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

title: Senior Social Content Producer
description:
Up to BRL 220,000 per year (depending on experience) on a full time, contractor contract Fully remote working anywhere in Brazil!

Work with the latest high-end hardware and creative software.

You’ll develop your AI edge — we’ll help you use and deepen your skills with AI tools so you stay ahead of the curve, not left behind by how the industry is changing.

A culture where ideas matter — your suggestions shape how we work.

⚡ Fast, flexible, and innovative — we move like a start-up with the backing of a global team.

Be part of a global team of 200+ talented colleagues.

Working hours : 9am – 5 : 30pm Pacific Time Zone, with a 1 hr lunch break

Role Snapshot

A multi-skilled, hands-on role leading the creative output as a versatile, social-first storyteller and writer.

You’ll be the creative engine on one high-profile entertainment account, spotting trends, pitching ideas, and turning TV and film moments into scroll-stopping social content. You’ll lead a small team as the day-to-day creative and production lead under the Account Manager, taking ideas from spark to post, managing (and partaking in) ideation, production workflows, copy, and owning the quality of what your team ships.

It’s a genuinely fast-paced agency environment with shifting priorities and tight deadlines, so you’ll need to enjoy that bit of pressure and stay calm and organized when things move quickly. You’ll also use AI in smart, safe ways to boost creativity and efficiency, keeping you ahead of the curve in this changing industry.

If you’re chronically online, obsessed with media and fandoms, love collaborating with others and excited to build upon your AI skills, we want to hear from you.

Who You Are

  • ✅ Culture-obsessed creative & Social-native storyteller : Chronically online, plugged into fandoms, memes and platform trends, and excited to turn them into smart ideas for TV and film IP. You think in hooks, formats and series, and understand how stories travel across different platforms.
  • ✅ Resilient under pressure with high agency : You thrive in a fast-moving environment with shifting priorities and tight deadlines. You spot problems and opportunities and take ownership to fix or pursue them without waiting to be asked.
  • ✅ Clear, confident communicator : Able to pitch ideas, give feedback and handle client comments calmly, clearly and constructively.
  • ✅ Team lead, accountable for output : You’re comfortable setting direction for a small team, giving clear feedback, and taking responsibility for the quality and timeliness of everything your team ships, not just your own tasks.
  • ✅ Organised producer : Strong on deadlines, details and juggling multiple titles at once, while keeping tools, calendars and asset libraries accurate.
  • ✅ AI-fluent creator : You already use AI tools and LLMs to boost your creativity and speed, and you’re curious about weaving them into everyday workflows.
  • ✅ Driven by doing great work : Energized by smart, well-crafted content, proud of the output, and focused on delivering for both clients and fans.

Not required but nice to haves

  • Experience in social-first production — creating or producing content specifically for social channels.
  • Copywriting Experience — writing creatively for any platform that showcases a strong tone of voice.
  • Entertainment or fandom experience — working on film / TV, streaming, gaming or other fandom-heavy brands.
  • Hands-on creative skills — basic design, editing or motion skills

Who We Are

At Storm Ideas, we supercharge the digital presence of some of the biggest names in US TV and entertainment. Since 2008, our international team has delivered bold, forward-thinking solutions for globally recognised clients.

Whether we're building innovative products, producing high-impact social content, or designing smarter ways for our partners to work—we’re right at the cutting edge of creativity, technology, and automation.

Embracing Future-Facing Technology

Emerging technologies like Artificial Intelligence present exciting opportunities for us and our clients. As the world adapts, we’re committed to safely exploring the potential advantages of AI, integrating it thoughtfully into our work where possible, and one day guiding our clients through new possibilities when they’re open and ready for them. By tapping into our creativity, expertise, and collaboration, we aim to embrace its potential together. Our vision relies on people who are curious about this technology and excited to take on this challenge!

What You’ll Make Happen

Lead the day-to-day production workflow, turning brand priorities, fandom insights and social trends into clear, platform-native and reactive content ideas across platforms.

Describe concepts in detail and turn approved ideas into thorough, practical briefs for editors, motion graphic artists and designers, including references, formats, specs and deliverable lists.

Own the production pipeline : download and organize footage and other assets, assign tasks, track progress, remove blockers and push others to make deadlines.

Populate and maintain internal tools (for example Airtable, content calendars and trackers) with accurate client data, improving structures over time and raising any discrepancies early.

Communicate directly with clients on ideas and assets : present concepts, gather feedback, and adjust work without losing creative strength.

Create social-first content yourself : writing copy (captions, overlays, CTAs, post text) and producing simple visual assets (for example images with text or basic layouts) ready for publishing.

Run quality assurance checks on all assets before delivery, catching errors, off-brand details or non-compliance with specs and platform requirements.

Line manage a small team (around 3–5 people) : set priorities, delegate work, give clear feedback and support their development in both craft and process.

Be an expert in social platforms, trends and Storm Ideas products, using that knowledge to suggest smart strategies and content approaches that engage audiences and achieve client goals.

Use AI tools and LLMs to support your own creativity and efficiency, and spot opportunities to plug our AI systems into workflows (for example tagging, first-draft copy or asset variations), working with the wider team to trial and embed improvements.

Manage and grow your direct reports. Hold regular 1 : 1s, set goals, give honest feedback and make sure your team has the support, clarity and coaching they need to do their best work.

Application

Along with your CV, please send us a cover letter that tells us why you’re the perfect fit for this role, PLUS, make us a meme! Try your best to make us laugh with a simple text-on-image meme using TV or Film IP. We’d also LOVE if you could let us know your current favourite social media trend and why!

RECRUITMENT PROCESS

Initial Video Questions

If shortlisted, you’ll be invited to complete a short set of questions via our online video platform.

First Interview

You’ll then have an interview with a member of our recruitment team to discuss your experience, skills, and interest in the role.

Creative Task (if applicable)

We may ask you to prepare a few creative ideas or examples of your work ahead of the next stage.

Final Interview

The final stage will be an interview with Louise Sables, our CEO and Nina Bicket, Head of Content Production. This is your opportunity to talk in more depth about your creative approach and how you could contribute to our team.

Not sure if you tick every box? Apply anyway — we value potential, mindset, and ambition as much as experience.

title: FF&E Supply chain Manager
description:
This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations.

We are seeking a highly organized and experienced FF&E Supply Chain Project Manager to oversee the full logistics, quality control, and delivery process for a luxury residential hospitality project in Brazil. This role is responsible for managing production follow-up, factory coordination, inbound logistics from multiple regions (Brazil and Europe), storage operations in Preá, and final‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara—an area with challenging access conditions.

The ideal candidate has strong project management skills, experience in complex supply‑chain environments, and the ability to work collaboratively with vendors, factories, construction teams, installers, and logistics partners.

At a Glance:

  1. Mid–Senior role overseeing end‑to‑end FF&E supply chain for a luxury hospitality project in Brazil
  2. Responsible for factory supervision, quality control, and production sign‑off (Brazil & Europe)
  3. Manages storage operations in Preá and all inbound logistics
  4. Coordinates last‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara with specialized 4x4/off‑road vehicles
  5. Oversees inventory accuracy, documentation, dispatch & receiving
  6. Plans and supervises loading/unloading, equipment rental, and batch delivery scheduling
  7. Works closely with Construction for delivery timelines, site readiness, and installation planning
  8. Supervises Utopia‑hired installers to ensure deadlines, quality standards, and contractual commitments
  9. Must be highly organized, proactive, and experienced in complex or remote logistics environments

Responsibilities

Production Oversight & Quality Control

  • Supervise FF&E production at each factory (Brazil & Europe).
  • Conduct detailed quality checks and approve inventory before packing and sign‑off.
  • Ensure all items meet Utopia’s standards for quality, specifications, and finishes.

Inbound Logistics & Storage Management

  • Monitor and confirm the arrival of goods at the Preá storage facility.
  • Arrange and oversee loading/unloading operations at all locations.
  • Hire necessary local equipment or machinery as required.
  • Maintain a full, accurate, and continuously updated inventory of all items.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Handle all dispatch, receiving, and transport paperwork.
  • Ensure complete documentation for internal controls and auditing.

Delivery Coordination & Final‑Mile Logistics

  • Oversee delivery schedules from factories to Preá, ensuring timely arrivals.
  • Plan and manage logistics from Preá to Jericoacoara—including batch deliveries due to access restrictions (large trucks cannot cross dunes).
  • Hire and coordinate appropriate 4x4 or off‑road trucks capable of operating in sandy conditions.
  • Supervise all loading/unloading operations for the Preá–Jericoacoara transfers.

On‑Site Coordination & Installation Support

  • Coordinate delivery timelines and equipment needs with the Construction team.
  • Organize and supervise unpacking activities.
  • Oversee Utopia‑hired installation teams to ensure full compliance with contract requirements, deadlines, and quality standards.

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in FF&E logistics, supply chain management, project management, or procurement—preferably in hospitality or high‑end residential projects.
  • Proven experience supervising factory production, performing quality checks, and managing sign‑off processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate international and domestic logistics (Brazil + Europe preferred).
  • Experience managing storage facilities, inventory systems, and warehouse operations.
  • Solid track record overseeing loading/unloading operations, equipment rental, and transport coordination.
  • Hands‑on experience with remote or difficult‑access job sites (desert, beach, island, jungle environments are a strong plus).
  • Experience coordinating with construction teams, installers, and multiple vendors simultaneously.
  • Prior responsibility for delivery scheduling, documentation, and compliance.
  • Experience supervising installation teams is highly desirable.
  • Portuguese and English a must - any other language a plus.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of FF&E manufacturing processes, materials, finishes, and quality standards.
  • Proficiency in inventory management tools, tracking systems, and documentation workflows.
  • Understanding of logistics planning, especially final‑mile or off‑road delivery constraints.
  • Familiarity with transport regulations, customs basics, and dispatch/receiving procedures.
  • Strong reporting and documentation skills (photos, checklists, receiving logs, QC reports).
  • Ability to read technical documents (spec sheets, shop drawings, BOQs).

Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience.

Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Main responsibilities

Executar atividades de nutrição revisando os cardápios e dietas dos pacientes, bem como adequando o teor nutricional dos alimentos a fim de assegurar o atendimento das prescrições médicas.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Nutrição
  • Especialização completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Nutrição em Pediatria, Nutrição em Materno Infantil, Nutrição Clínica, Nutrição Geriatria e Gerontologia, Nutrição em Fitoterapia Nutricional ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde

WHAT YOU'LL DO

We’re seeking a Senior Data Engineer to lead the integration and modernization of a recently acquired company’s data ecosystem. You’ll collaborate closely with our new colleagues to learn, document, and understand their existing data product — currently based on Python and Airtable — and work to evolve it into our modern Google Cloud Platform (GCP) stack.

This is a hands‑on, strategic role that combines architecture, delivery excellence, and collaboration. You’ll bring strong software engineering discipline to our data workflows, ensuring all pipelines are built with testability, version control, and CI/CD best practices in mind.

Bridge and Modernize Systems

  • Learn and document the acquired company’s current data ecosystem, including Airtable structures, Python scripts, and API integrations.
  • Translate that understanding into clear technical documentation and communicate findings back to our internal data and engineering teams.
  • Design and lead a modernization roadmap to integrate their systems into our GCP‑based medallion architecture.
  • Champion pragmatic migration strategies that balance business continuity with long‑term scalability.

Design and Deliver Robust Data Pipelines

  • Build, orchestrate, and maintain scalable ELT pipelines using Astro (Airflow), DBT, and BigQuery.
  • Ingest data from APIs and third‑party systems into our unified data model.

title: Delivery Operations Analyst
description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta is a platform that helps people manage equity, build businesses, and invest in the companies of tomorrow. Our mission is to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places.

Carta is trusted by more than 40,000 companies and over two million people in nearly 160 countries to manage cap tables, compensation, and valuations. Carta also supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, and represents nearly $130B in assets under administration. Carta’s tender offer solutions have returned $14B to shareholders in secondary transactions. Today, Carta’s platform manages nearly three trillion dollars in equity globally.

The Problems You'll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

The role involves tasks like analyzing business operations and identifying customer needs in order to bring the two closer together. They should maintain a high attention to detail, strong quantitative analysis, and have the ability to juggle multiple competing priorities across a variety of audiences (from IC’s to senior / exec level staff).

  • Analytical Excellence
  • Ability to track and analyze reports and data queries
  • Identify customer needs and align processes with the customer journey
  • Develop operational improvement plans informed by data
  • Skills with the use of Google Drive Suite, such as Word and Excel
  • Leverage strong quantitative and analytical skills to address specific data requests and find correlations from analysis
  • Experience with advanced computer systems and BI analytics systems, such as Looker, Salesforce, HTML and maintains some knowledge of content management systems
  • Ability to tell the story of the customer journey through a growing level of business acumen and, ultimately, learning how to improve the lives of both internal and external stakeholders
  • Manage quality, costs and the efficiency of the organization
  • Reengineer and streamline processes to improve efficiency, leverage and productivity
  • Train Client Services operations staff
  • Conduct operational research
  • Solves complex problems relating to the operation of the Client Services
  • Stays up-to-date on software that is commonly used in the industry
  • Drive Operational Excellence “Think Big Picture”
  • Analyze how information is recorded and how the process can be improved
  • Analyze customer needs and determine how operations can be altered to improve service to customers and better meet their needs
  • Work to increase the value of a business
  • Oversee quality control and recommend process improvements for everyday operating procedures
  • Promote a smooth delivery system for products and services to clients
  • Be able to create and drive an Implementation Plan or Business Plan

The Team You'll Work With

We are looking for a Delivery Operations Analyst to join our GTM Operations Department. The Operations Analyst will be responsible for owning and driving tasks that overall benefit the delivery organization. Their primary objective is to assist the teams they partner with to leverage process improvement, analytical excellence, and tools implementation to better drive a more efficient cost-to-serve model.

About You

  • Problem solving and investigative skills – proactive approach that ends up solving high-leverage problems
  • People skills – willing and able to speak confidently to senior leadership about key process improvement opportunities
  • Self-motivated and dependable
  • Project management skills / ability to meet deadlines – meet performance and schedule timelines on key initiatives / operational tasks
  • Adaptable and proactive – displays “can do” winning approach to every operational encounter
  • Consistency, accuracy and prowess to execution – maniacal focus on excellence and integrity
  • Leadership capabilities – ability to cross-functionally communicate with leadership
  • Multitasking – able to swiftly move through projects with perseverance and poise

Important Security Notice for Candidates

Our company has been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will come from an @carta.com domain. Be cautious of any requests for sensitive information or payments outside of our official channels. For more information about this type of scam, please review information provided by the Federal Trade Commission (FTC). If you encounter any suspicious activity, please report it immediately.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the recruiter via email. As a company, we value fairness, helpfulness, transparency, leadership and build our teams around these values. Check out our website to get to know us better as you think about your next step at Carta.

We seek a talented Computational Scientist with an M.Sc. in Computational Science or Engineering and academic and/or professional experience.   • Familiarity with open‑source scientific computing libraries (e.g., HYPRE, BOOST++, PETSC, DUNE, LAPACK, etc.).
  • Familiarity with CMake, Makefiles, and other tools for multi‑platform code compilation.
  • Knowledge of fluid flow physics.

title: INSTRUMENTADOR CIRÚRGICO - CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO
description:
Job description

CENTRO DO OLHO CARIOCA está localizado na região central da cidade, no Bairro de Benfica. Os serviços prestados abrangem toda a população carioca, residente da cidade. É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.

A unidade de saúde é preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como:

  • diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas;
  • realização de exames para correção refrativa e adaptação de lentes de contacto, bem como para análise da função visual;
  • avaliação da condução nervosa do estímulo visual e das deficiências do campo visual;
  • programação e utilização de terapêuticas específicas de recuperação e reeducação das perturbações da visão binocular e de subvisão;
  • ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde;
  • realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação.

Main responsibilities

Atuar junto à equipe cirúrgica, se responsabilizando pela organização, quantidade e qualidade do funcionamento do instrumental e de equipamentos a serem utilizados pela equipe cirúrgica, estando atento a controle de reposição e devolução.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Médio Completo
  • Curso Completo de Técnico de Enfermagem e Instrumentação Cirúrgica
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe
  • Experiência mínima de 06 meses comprovada na função de Instrumentador Cirúrgico

Additional information

  • 40H SEMANAIS, DE SEGUNDA A SEXTA-FEIRA
  • VAGA DIARISTA, SEM POSSIBILIDADE DE CONCILIAR.
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

Consultor(a) Comercial Externo - Vaga Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD) | Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Stone Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros, focada no cliente e na transformação da indústria de pagamentos para apoiar o empreendedorismo brasileiro. Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades.

Como Será Seu Dia a Dia

  • Atuará em rotina externa para prospectar novos clientes na rota do polo.
  • Gerenciar a carteira de clientes ativos e de pós-venda.
  • Participar das matinais diárias do time para traçar os seus planos, metas e trocas de aprendizados.

Conheça um pouco mais a rotina do Agente Stone no nosso manifesto.

Requisitos e Qualificações

Nossos Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Hospital Virtual Verde, disponível 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, de forma rápida e prática
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação - Pluxee
  • Wellhub

  • Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com acesso a diversos livros, podcasts, treinamentos e vídeo aulas visando o autodesenvolvimento (Studa e Biblioteca StoneCo)

Nossa Cultura

A nossa cultura se manifesta em cada encontro e em cada diálogo, seja entre colegas de trabalho ou com clientes, seja nas reuniões internas ou em nossas respostas às transformações do mercado e aos momentos de adversidade. Desejamos que cada pessoa sinta orgulho de ser quem é e que sinta ainda mais orgulho de fazer parte da nossa história. A essência de "ser quem você é" nos guia, inspirando a construção diária de um ambiente livre, que celebra e valoriza as singularidades. Sabemos que cada pessoa traz consigo uma perspectiva única e valiosa. O que nos une é a inteligência, a energia e a integridade – virtudes que podem e devem ser cultivadas em qualquer pessoa. Nos dedicaremos todos os dias para garantir que nossas práticas, nossa cultura e nosso ambiente estejam sempre orientados pela inclusão, acessibilidade e respeito.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

  • ⚡Own It: Espírito de dono traz liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo que entregamos e buscamos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
  • Live the Ride: Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com erros e vemos desafios como oportunidades de crescimento.
  • No Bullshit: Agimos com simplicidade. Somos práticos, sinceros e valorizamos feedbacks, usando transparência para evoluir, mesmo em erros.

Formação Acadêmica

CNH B Definitiva

NÓS SOMOS HEINEKEN!

No Brasil, já crescemos muito e estamos em um novo momento ainda mais movidos pela paixão em sermos a melhor cervejaria para nosso time, parceiros, clientes, consumidores e toda a sociedade. É assim que caminhamos diariamente em busca da realização do nosso sonho no Brasil: levar nossa estrela em cada coração e em cada copo brasileiro.

Main responsibilities

Descrição do perfil

Responsável por liderar a condução de projetos e iniciativas ágeis de ponta a ponta, desde a definição das histórias e priorização do backlog até o acompanhamento da entrega final, assegurando a qualidade e integridade conceitual das entregas. Atua garantindo o alinhamento entre as áreas de negócio e técnica para assegurar que as entregas estejam alinhadas ao escopo definido e aos objetivos da empresa. Além disso, mantém as práticas Scrum, apoia os outros papéis e garante comunicação e colaboração ativa entre squads, atuando como educador para assegurar o respeito aos valores e metodologia ágil.

Principais atividades

  • Apoiar a gestão de projetos de lançamento de novas ofertas considerando atividades E2E, desde a solicitação do gerente de produto até o delivery técnico;
  • Definir a visão do produto, seu roadmap e oportunidades de crescimento com os diversos stakeholders;
  • Construir escopo junto com Líder de Produto, atuando no processo de elaboração de user stories garantindo requisitos necessários e alinhamento de expectativas junto às áreas de negócio;
  • Liderar grupos multidisciplinares para garantir a correta especificação do produto, ajudando na análise e negociação de impactos diretamente com as áreas de negócio;
  • Desafiar as áreas de negócio acerca de features de produtos, processos ou regras;
  • Traduzir a estratégia de negócios para o time técnico, garantindo o entendimento dos requisitos;
  • Negociar escopos prioritários com foco na estratégia de negócios, discutindo trade-offs estratégicos;
  • Validar refinamentos técnicos garantindo aderência ao escopo solicitado;
  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis de alta transversalidade (diversas esteiras/sprints de desenvolvimento), centralizando decisões estratégicas;
  • Elaborar critérios de aceite para garantir alinhamento com demais times envolvidos, assegurando visão única de projeto/produto;
  • Realizar a validação e aprovação dos testes garantindo a qualidade da entrega e coordenar aprovação dos demais times envolvidos;
  • Acompanhar entrega e performance dos testes pós-produção para garantir funcionamento e velocidade na correção;
  • Apontar issues para serem endereçados pelo time técnico identificado;
  • Controlar cronograma e budget dos projetos garantindo aderência à estratégia;
  • Manter um olhar atento, crítico e propositivo durante todas as etapas do projeto, utilizando dados, aprendizados e feedbacks para monitorar a aderência ao processo e propor melhorias contínuas de forma assertiva;
  • Garantir a manutenção das práticas Scrum, apoiar os papéis envolvidos e manter a comunicação e colaboração ativa entre squads;
  • Atuar como educador para assegurar que todos os participantes conheçam e respeitem os princípios e valores do Scrum.

Requirements and skills

Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação

  • Experiência como Product Owner, Project Manager ou Scrum Master com atuação prática em projetos ágeis;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de backlog, elaboração de histórias e releases;
  • Capacidade de atuar com diferentes stakeholders e áreas técnicas, negociando escopos e prazos;
  • Habilidade para escrever e organizar user stories, critérios de aceite e planos de entrega;
  • Conhecimento em rituais ágeis e na condução de cerimônias com múltiplas esteiras ou times;
  • Perfil analítico, estruturado e com forte senso de responsabilidade pela entrega de valor;
  • Ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Azure, Jira, Monday;
  • Boa capacidade de articulação, visão crítica e habilidade de propor melhorias processuais com base em experiência prática;
  • Inglês avançado é obrigatório;
  • Graduação Completa em Administração/Marketing/Tecnologia/Engenharia

Additional information

description:
About EightpointEightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners.

With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings.

Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most‑used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web.

Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real‑world value.

Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.

About the Role

You’ll be working alongside our Lead Desktop Designer day‑to‑day, while also collaborating regularly with the larger design team, motion graphics team, and user acquisition team to bring ideas to life from wireframes to polished UIs.

While the lead drives the vision, you’ll turn concepts into reality with speed, precision, and polish.

You’ll also stay responsive to shifting priorities, adapt to quick turnarounds, and always design with developer feasibility in mind.

This is not a research‑ or strategy‑heavy role.

We’re looking for someone who’s happy to execute, tweak, and finesse.

If you love clean pixels, smooth systems, and being the reliable engine behind great product design this is your role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate wireframes and rough concepts into crisp, production‑ready designs
  • Build and maintain high‑quality UI components for browser extensions and desktop apps
  • Collaborate closely with our lead designer and developers to ensure fast, clean handoff
  • Make smart decisions about when to polish vs. when to ship
  • Adapt to shifting priorities and irregular work cadences without missing a beat
  • Keep designs tight, lean, and respectful of developer constraints
  • Bring taste and craft, even to tight‑turnaround projects
  • Contribute to a shared design system and maintain consistency across platforms

Who You Are

  • 3+ years of UI / UX experience with a strong emphasis on desktop design
  • A portfolio that shows clean, dev‑friendly UI work—bonus for any browser‑related experience or browser extension examples
  • Deep proficiency with Figma and an efficient, systemized approach to design
  • Ability to take direction, iterate fast, and not get precious
  • Strong eye for detail and consistency
  • Comfort working in ambiguity and shifting strategies
  • Respect for dev workloads—your work should make their lives easier, not harder
  • Reliable, communicative, and fun to work with under pressure

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing responsive layouts for desktop applications, with consideration for mobile and adaptive views
  • Light working knowledge of HTML / CSS / JS (enough to understand constraints)
  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney) for speed and inspiration
  • Familiarity with accessibility and internationalization basics

The ServiceNow Technical Expert will play a pivotal role in building and evolving ServiceNow as the “IT ERP” for the newco IT organization.   • Training : Provide Training regarding ServiceNow stretching from End Users to Technical Staff and Architects.

Expectations

  • Prioritize out-of-the-box functionality and avoid custom development unless justified by business case, legal, EHS, or security requirements.

  • Demonstrate proactive problem-solving and consultative guidance across modules.
  • Maintain clear and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure all architectural decisions are aligned with the enterprise roadmap and scoped demands.

Qualifications

  • Must-Have : ServiceNow Administrator certification or equivalent. Additional certifications in the context of ITIL functionality are beneficial.
  • Proven experience in scripting and integration within ServiceNow.
  • Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.
  • Basic knowledge of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid).
  • Nice-to-Have : Familiarity with architectural frameworks such as CSDM and TOGAF.
  • Experience across multiple ServiceNow modules.
  • Understanding of enterprise IT transformation and ERP-like platform design.

Authorization

  • Make architectural and configuration decisions within the roadmap provided by the Enterprise Architect and the scope defined by Process Owners and DSMs.
  • Represent BEXIT in cross-functional meetings and initiatives as a subject matter expert (SME).
  • Approve configuration and development work that aligns with best practices and avoids unnecessary customization or technical debt.
  • Guide and supervise external partners in development and application management activities.
